title: Prism Breaker
tagline: Twelve levels of light, one paddle between them.
description: A brick breaker with weight: the ball takes english off the paddle, bricks come in three densities, and every level you clear is remembered so you can pick the run back up where you left it.
author: HexCave
controls: Move the mouse, or arrow keys / A-D
howToPlay: Move the paddle with the mouse, or with the arrow keys or A and D.
Press space or click to launch the ball, then keep it off the floor.
Where the ball hits the paddle decides where it goes: the edges send it out at a sharp angle, the centre sends it straight up.
Bricks come in three densities — the dimmer ones need more than one hit, and deeper rows are tougher.
Clearing every brick finishes the level and unlocks the next one. Losing all three balls sends you back to the start of the level you were on.
The ball speeds up slightly with each paddle hit, and each level launches it faster than the last.
goal: Clear all twelve levels. Every level you reach is unlocked permanently, so you can pick the run back up later.
